rule: working set = median over pilot seeds of each seed's median stock-LRU (A1) mean unique reachable bytes at pressure pools (large-pool cells excluded); primary pool = 1.0x working set; D8 secondary pool = the pilot-tested 1,254 MiB (about 0.6x)
change_record: Revision 4 planned a 0.5x pool. Pilot round 3 (single seed 21002) showed that at about 0.5-0.6x the 50% hold cap holds roughly one session and HM's 256 MiB pool could not hold a usable hybrid prefix (no benefit), so the 1.0x level, defined from the working-set rule before its A7 result was seen, became primary and the lower D8 level is retained as secondary. Both levels are reported.
